ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
libxml2_devel:
- '2.15'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zlib:
- '1'
name: libxmlpp-5.0
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.4.0"
  major_minor: ${{ (version | split("."))[:2] | join(".") }}
  abi_version: "5.0"

recipe:
  name: libxmlpp-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: http://ftp.gnome.org/pub/GNOME/sources/libxml++/${{ major_minor }}/libxml++-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: e9a23c436686a94698d2138e6bcbaf849121d63bfa0f50dc34fefbfd79566848

build:
  number: 4

outputs:

  # Performs the actual build - outputs
  # are inherited by packages below
  - staging:
      name: libxmlpp-build
    build:
      script: build_libxmlpp
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - xz-tools
        - meson
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - zlib
        - libxml2-devel
        - if: win
          then: liblzma-devel

  # ABI-specific runtime package
  - package:
      name: libxmlpp-${{ abi_version }}
    inherit: libxmlpp-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/xml++-vc143-${{ abi_version }}-1.dll
        - if: linux
          then: lib/libxml++-${{ abi_version }}.so.*
        - if: osx
          then: lib/libxml++-${{ abi_version }}*.dylib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - xz-tools
        - meson
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - zlib
        - libxml2-devel
        - if: win
          then: liblzma-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libxmlpp-" ~ abi_version, upper_bound="x.x") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - if: unix
              then: xml++-${{ abi_version }}
          files:
            - if: win
              then: Library/bin/xml++-vc143-${{ abi_version }}-1.dll

  # ABI-independent metapackage
  - package:
      name: libxmlpp
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libxmlpp-" ~ abi_version, exact=True) }}

  # Development package
  - package:
      name: libxmlpp-devel
    inherit: libxmlpp-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
           - Library/lib/*
           - Library/include/*
        - if: unix
          then:
            - include/*
            - lib/libxml++-${{ abi_version }}/*
            - lib/pkgconfig/*
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libxml++-${{ abi_version }}.so
    requirements:
      run:
        # run_exports does not apply to the package itself, so the runtime
        # library that the devel .so symlink points to must be a run dependency
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libxmlpp-" ~ abi_version, exact=True) }}
        - libxml2-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libxmlpp-" ~ abi_version, exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - env
          - pkg-config --exact-version=${{ version }} libxml++-${{ abi_version }}
      # Build and run a program against the installed package to check that
      # the headers, pkg-config file, and linked library are all usable.
      # Not on Windows, as pkg-config gives -l flags that MSVC does not accept.
      - if: unix
        then:
          - requirements:
              run:
                # Use the compiler metapackage an end user would install
                # rather than the compiler activation packages
                - cxx-compiler
                - pkg-config
            files:
              recipe:
                - tests/
            script:
              # cxx-compiler does not set compiler environment variables
              - if: linux
                then: export CXX=g++
              - if: osx
                then:
                  - export CXX=clang++
                  - export SDKROOT="${SDKROOT:-$(xcrun --show-sdk-path)}"
              - export CXXFLAGS="-std=c++17"
              - export LDFLAGS="-Wl,-rpath,${PREFIX}/lib"
              - ${CXX} ${CXXFLAGS} tests/test_libxmlpp.cpp -o test_libxmlpp $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libxml++-${{ abi_version }}) ${LDFLAGS}
              - ./test_libxmlpp

about:
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: C++ bindings for libxml2-devel
  homepage: https://libxmlplusplus.github.io/libxmlplusplus/
  repository: https://github.com/libxmlplusplus/libxmlplusplus
  documentation: https://libxmlplusplus.github.io/libxmlplusplus/

extra:
  # conda-smithy otherwise names the feedstock after the first output
  feedstock-name: libxmlpp
  recipe-maintainers:
    - scopatz
    - pauldmccarthy
